TATACHEM.d: Tata Chemicals manufactures soda ash, sodium bicarbonate, and basic chemistry products for glass, detergent, and industrial uses. It is a subsidiary of the Tata Group.

TATACOMM.d: Tata Communications provides global telecommunication services, cloud solutions, and managed security services to enterprise customers worldwide. The company operates an extensive international submarine cable network.

TATACONSUM.d: Tata Consumer Products produces and distributes food and beverage products, including tea, coffee, salt, and water. It serves retail consumers globally through supermarkets, grocery stores, and online channels.

TATAELXSI.d: Tata Elxsi provides design and technology services for the automotive, media, broadcast, and healthcare industries. The company operates as a subsidiary of the Tata Group.

TATAINVEST.d: Tata Investment Corporation is a non-banking financial company engaged in investing in long-term investments such as equity shares and mutual funds. It is a part of the Tata Group.

TATAPOWER.d: Tata Power Company generates, transmits, and distributes electricity from thermal, solar, wind, and hydro sources. It serves residential, commercial, and industrial consumers across India.

TATASTEEL.d: Tata Steel Limited manufactures and distributes a wide range of steel products for the construction, automotive, and industrial sectors. It is a major global steel producer and part of the Tata Group.

TATATECH.d: Tata Technologies Limited provides engineering services, product development, and digital solutions for the global automotive and aerospace industries. It operates as a subsidiary of Tata Motors and serves original equipment manufacturers worldwide.

TBOTEK.d: TBO Tek Limited operates a global travel distribution platform connecting buyers and suppliers. It serves travel agents and corporate clients worldwide.

TCS.d: Tata Consultancy Services provides information technology services, consulting, and business solutions to global enterprises. It is a subsidiary of the Tata Group and a major global IT services provider.

TECHM.d: Tech Mahindra Limited provides information technology services, networking solutions, and digital transformation consulting to global enterprises. It is part of the Mahindra Group.

TECHNOE.d: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction services for power infrastructure projects. Its main customers are power utilities and transmission companies across India.

TEGA.d: Tega Industries Limited manufactures specialized and consumable products for the global mineral beneficiation, mining, and bulk solids handling industries. Its solutions include mill liners, screens, and conveyor products.

THANGAMAYL.d: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited retails gold, silver, diamond, and platinum jewellery through its retail stores. The company primarily serves retail consumers in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.

THELEELA.d: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited owns and operates luxury hotels, palaces, and resorts across major Indian cities and tourist destinations. It caters to high-end business and leisure travelers.

THERMAX.d: Thermax Limited provides engineering solutions for heating, cooling, power, water treatment, and air pollution control. It serves industrial sectors such as energy, chemicals, cement, and steel globally.

TI.d: Tilaknagar Industries Limited manufactures, markets, and sells Indian Made Foreign Liquor, focusing on brandy. Its flagship product is Mansion House Brandy, distributed across multiple states in India.

TIINDIA.d: Tube Investments of India manufactures engineered steel tubes, roll-formed metal sections, bicycle chains, and industrial drive systems. Its primary customers include major automotive and industrial manufacturers.

TIMKEN.d: Timken India manufactures and distributes tapered roller bearings, mechanical power transmission components, and related services. Its main customers are automotive and industrial machinery sectors.

TITAN.d: Titan Company manufactures and retails watches, jewellery, eyewear, and precision engineering components. It serves retail consumers in India primarily through its branded store networks.

TMB.d: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank provides commercial banking and financial services to retail, micro, small, and medium enterprise customers. It operates a network of branches primarily across southern India.

TMCV.d: Tata Motors Limited manufactures commercial vehicles, including trucks, buses, and vans, for freight and passenger transport. It is a major commercial vehicle manufacturer in India.

TORNTPHARM.d: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and markets branded generic pharmaceutical products across key therapeutic segments globally. It is the flagship company of the Torrent Group.

TORNTPOWER.d: Torrent Power Limited generates, transmits, and distributes electricity across thermal, hydro, and renewable energy sources in India. It serves millions of residential, commercial, and industrial customers.

TRENT.d: Trent Limited operates retail stores under formats including Westside, Zudio, and Star. It is a retail subsidiary of the Tata Group.

TRIDENT.d: Trident Limited manufactures and sells home textile products, paper, and chemicals. Its main customers include global retail brands, hospitality sectors, and domestic consumers.

TRITURBINE.d: Triveni Turbine manufactures industrial steam turbines up to 100 megawatts for power generation and co-generation. It serves sugar, steel, paper, and other process industries globally.

TVSMOTOR.d: TVS Motor Company Limited manufactures motorcycles, scooters, and three-wheelers for domestic and international markets. It is one of India's prominent two-wheeler manufacturers.
